messages:
deploy-bot: Starting multi-service deploy to production (change window: 2026-03-20 02:00-03:00 UTC). Target services: runtime, api, console. Strategy: staggered wave (runtime -> api -> console).
deploy-bot: runtime -> tag:v3.4.1 (commit `a1b2c3d`), api -> tag:v2.8.0 (commit `d4e5f6g`), console -> tag:v1.12.6 (commit `h7i8j9k`).
Alex K: Copying notes here — runtime has the new KV cache change + ATTN opt. Watch p50/p95/p99.
Priya M: Noted. I'll monitor runtime metrics and be ready to abort.
Jesse L: Will validate api smoke once runtime is green. Have rollback pins prepared: runtime->v3.4.0, api->v2.7.9, console->v1.12.5.
Rita S: FYI I registered the change in the calendar and updated the runbook: /runbooks/deploys/multi-service-wave.md :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: runtime deploy started on prod-cluster-1 (pool GPU-A). Instances: 6.
deploy-bot: runtime: 6/6 updated — healthchecks passing (initial).
Alex K: Quick perf check: initial p95 looks OK but I'm seeing small increase in p99. Holding for 2 mins.
Priya M: I see p99 spike to 820ms on a subset of hosts (3/6). Adding tag to trace: `trace:kv_hotpath`.
Jesse L: Can you post the logs snippet?
Priya M: paste: ```
[2026-03-20T02:05:12Z] runtime-node-3 ERROR tail_latency=1220ms route=/generate seq=1024 kv_miss=true
[2026-03-20T02:05:13Z] runtime-node-4 WARN tail_latency=980ms route=/generate seq=512 kv_miss=true
```
SRE Oncall: Seeing increased retransmits from node-3, might be network noisy. Pin runtime?
Alex K: I'm leaning to pause wave and rollback runtime to v3.4.0 — we can't risk p99 > 1s for prod. Thoughts?
Jesse L: Agree. We should abort api/console wave until runtime stable.
Rita S: Approve rollback. I'll trigger the pin in the deploy dashboard.
deploy-bot: Aborting remaining waves (api/console). Runtime rollback initiated -> pin to tag:v3.4.0 (commit `z9y8x7w`).
deploy-bot: runtime rollback in progress: 3/6 nodes already rolled back, healthchecks pending.
Priya M: After rollback started, p99 on node-3 dropped to 180ms. Node-4 at 140ms. Looks like the new kv path was the culprit.
Alex K: Good catch. Leave runtime on pinned v3.4.0 for now. We'll open a follow-up PR to iterate on KV caching strategy and add more unit tests for seq lengths.
SRE Oncall: Marking incident for postmortem: INC-2026-0319. Assigning to Alex and Priya.
Jesse L: For api and console — will hold deployments. When do we reschedule? Prefer to wait for the runtime fix + staging run.
Rita S: Changing change window: cleared for now. I'll update the release notes to reflect partial deploy + runtime rollback.
Alex K: Notes to include in release: runtime v3.4.1 aborted due to KV tail-latency on certain sequences; rolled back to v3.4.0; api and console not deployed.
Priya M: Adding eval checklist for next attempt: synthetic seq 1024 KV-heavy load, A/B compare p99, enable extra logging for kv path.
Jesse L: When we re-run, recommend staggered with longer observation between runtime->api (5m) and api->console (3m).
Rita S: I'll coordinate a new change window — proposing 2026-03-22 02:00-03:30 UTC to allow extra soak.
SRE Oncall: If anyone needs quick rollback commands: `rd-deploy rollback runtime --to v3.4.0 --force` and `rd-deploy pin runtime:v3.4.0`.
Alex K: Thanks all. Closing this thread — follow-up doc & postmortem will be linked once ready. :wave:
